shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

shared.zh: 能用的显示方式，第一种是起始；只有一种时玩家不能切换
shared.en: the views it may be drawn in, the first to start in; with one, the player cannot switch

shared.zh: 每种形状默认的显示方式（没写的用库里的第一种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in by default (the library’s first where none is given)

shared.zh: 引言或通关文案旁显示的一个值
shared.en: a value shown beside an introduction page or a pass text

about.en: a value shown beside the pass text

shared.zh: 通过后最后一个任务的板成为元件 type：它的输入口和结果口就是那个任务的输入和输出
shared.en: once passed the last task’s board is the part `type`: its ports are that task’s inputs and outputs

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：为什么
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: why

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

about.zh: 这次升级留下的管线分段名称
about.en: the pipeline stage this upgrade contributes

shared.zh: 这个任务自己的引言：第一次做到它时读（第一个任务的接在这一关的后面）
shared.en: the task’s own intro: read the first time it is played (the first task’s after the level’s)

shared.zh: 这个任务通过时说的话（最后一个任务用这一关的点题）
shared.en: what passing the task says (the last task says the level’s pass text)

about.zh: 每个输入或输出的值，按名字
about.en: a value for each input or output, by name

shared.zh: 隐藏测试：每次运行一并检查，通关后公开；只合上可见测试的板过不了它
shared.en: hidden tests: checked with every run and shown once passed; a board that only fits the visible tests fails them

about.zh: 一块板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 直觉上的错解：看起来能做、其实过不了这个任务的板，必须失败
shared.en: the naive answer: a board that looks right and is not, which must fail

about.zh: 显示哪一项：任务的一个口
about.en: what the row shows: one of the task’s ports

shared.zh: 结果区的几行，按顺序；不写就是领域默认的几行
shared.en: the results area’s rows, in order; without them the domain’s default rows

shared.zh: 这个任务里每种形状的显示方式（换掉游戏默认的那几种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in in this task (in place of the game’s)

shared.zh: 依次做的任务，最后一个通过就通过这一关
shared.en: the tasks done in turn; passing the last passes the level
